officialEvidence.operatorIdentity: The City of Aalen confirms Stadtwerke Aalen GmbH & Co. KG as the municipal utility; no current official public-charging tariff matrix was exposed in this pass.

stationEvidence.observation: Current station-level discovery sources report 0.35 EUR/kWh on several Stadtwerke Aalen AC EVSEs, but DE*BDO is a backend/shared prefix and the value is not an official operator-wide price. Other current station sources still report the direct-payment price as unknown, so no universal fallback is created.

decision: Keep Aalen partial and deferred. The operator is established and ad-hoc capability exists at public stations, but a current authoritative per-station checkout or official network price is missing. Do not extrapolate the 0.35 EUR/kWh observations and do not treat DE*BDO as an exclusive Stadtwerke Aalen prefix.
